resources.string: Copying the backup to the other places…
Comparing with the saves on the console…
Nothing changed since the last backup
No save files found. Play a game and save first.
Nothing to back up to: the internal storage and EASYROMS aren\'t available.
Not enough free space for a backup on the internal storage or EASYROMS.
The backup couldn\'t be written. The SD card may be failing: copy your saves to a PC.
No USB drive found. Plug one in and try again.
Nothing was restored: the saves it would replace couldn\'t be backed up first. Free up some space and try again.
A backup is running. Try again in a moment.
Save backup couldn\'t run. Restart the console and try again.
Pick a backup, then all of it or one game. You see what changes before anything is written.
Back up to USB drive now
Plug in a USB drive to keep a copy away from the SD card
Once a day while charging, and after you close a game. Skipped when nothing changed.
The newest %1$s are kept, with at least one from each recent day. Older ones are deleted.

Backups go to two places: Internal storage/Backups/Saves and EASYROMS/backups/saves, plus a USB drive when one is plugged in. Both places are on the same SD card, so copy the backups to a PC or USB drive now and then. Saves from RetroArch, PPSSPP and save files next to your games are included.
No backups yet. Use Back up now, or wait for the daily backup while charging.
This backup is damaged and can\'t be read (on %1$s)
All %1$s from this backup. You see what changes first.
